hidden_risks: Whether all listed kit components (receipt printer, software, barcode scanner) are actually included
Operational status and internal hardware specifications of the terminal
Whether the item is actively in stock or just a promotional dealer placeholder
response.best_proof: A physical photograph showing all bundled components of the POS kit together and powered on
seller_claims_unsupported: Seller text describes a cash drawer while the title and photo show a touchscreen POS terminal
Unverified inclusion of software, receipt printer, and barcode scanner
response.drop_reason: Dealer/vendor advertisement selling brand-new equipment using a stock catalogue photo, not a second-hand item.
response.failure_mode: AI might be confused by the contradictory text (cash drawer vs title POS kit) and the stock photo, leading to incorrect item categorization and flawed valuation.
